parent: Phase-20 data-independent random rank-5 FAIL; Phase-17 full raw 3x3 stencil PASS
question: Under a data-independent nested orthogonal basis of the same local 3x3 patch, at what per-channel spatial rank does the context-only token dynamics recover robust transfer across wave, Gray-Scott, unseen NLS, and unseen advection?

spatial_basis.method: per-channel 9x9 orthogonal matrix from QR of a seeded iid Gaussian matrix; row signs canonicalized; no physics data used
spatial_basis.nesting_rule: rank k uses the first k rows of the same per-channel 9x9 orthogonal matrix within a replicate

identifier.recursive_state_projection: same frozen Phase-10 18-bit companded token representation after every predicted step

paired_design: Within each replicate, all five ranks use exactly the same representation codebooks, physical evaluation trajectories, context, targets, and full 9x9 orthogonal basis; only the retained row count changes.
primary_rule: A rank k is declared sufficient under Phase 21 only if every one of 3 fresh registered replicates has companded rollout MSE / raw-state persistence MSE < 1.0 on all 15 splits: 45/45 cells. The primary Phase-21 outcome is the smallest tested sufficient rank. If no tested rank qualifies, report NO_THRESHOLD_FOUND. No retry or replacement of consumed replicate seeds.
secondary_diagnostics: paired ratio change as rank increases
rank-9 comparison against the raw full-stencil Phase-17 diagnostic
failure_policy: All registered outcomes are retained. An unfavorable rank or replicate may not be replaced. A higher-rank pass cannot retroactively redefine a lower-rank failure.
claim_limit: Synthetic known-law systems only. A threshold found under these random nested projections is not a universal operator-dimension lower bound and does not prove unrestricted law discovery. It only measures sufficiency within this fixed local patch, token representation, ridge identifier, simulator suite, and projection family.
